| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from_business` | `string` | **yes** | The id of the business to copy coupons from (biz_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `transfer_configuration`. One of `transfer_configuration`. |
| `id` | `string` | The transfer id. |
| `status` | `string` | The transfer state. One of `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`. |
| `source_business` | `string` | The business that the objects come from. |
| `destination_business` | `string` | The business that receives the objects. |
| `sections` | `array of string` | The sections that the transfer covers. |
| `wipe_destination` | `boolean` | True if the transfer cleared the destination first. |
| `report` | `object` | What the transfer did, for each section. |
| `error` | `string` | The error, if the transfer failed. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the transfer started. |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the transfer last changed. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Transfer job report |
| `400` | Invalid body / transfer error |
| `403` | Requires an all-mode API key |
| `404` | No such source business |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |
| `422` | Transfer failed |

```bash [Request]
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{

  }'
```
